verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a public first-party GitHub repository (stackblitz/bolt.new) describing the product's own capabilities, which suggests some product source can be read. Nothing in the pack names a license or confirms that the repo matches the hosted product at bolt.new. The Code view and GitHub-sync items concern users' own project code, not the product's source, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: any evidence of an open-source license, confirmation that the repo reflects the current hosted product, and independent corroboration.
